yamlCheck.dateAnchor: No calendar day, month or year is spoken. October 13–14, 1748 is conditional on the registered YAML calendar; the transcript independently supplies lunch, a sailing day, overnight passage and morning arrival.
yamlCheck.explanation: The adventure runs from lunch departure through one overnight and the following morning’s cave expedition, ending directly after the aboleth dies. No second day transition is established. The ten-minute rest and nested scouting add no calendar boundary. The interval matches relative to the disclosed YAML start, without independently verifying its absolute date.
